0022600163.text: The Bulls (1-5, on a four-game losing streak and 13th in the East) visit the 76ers (6-1, winners of three straight and 1st in the East) for Chicago's seventh game of the season. This season's series has no games yet, but Chicago won the 2025-26 series 2-1, and the last meeting, on March 25 in Philadelphia, ended with the Bulls losing 157-137. Chicago is without Nic Claxton (out, hamstring), while Jalen Smith (finger sprain) and Tobe Awaka (ankle sprain) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), and Joel Embiid is day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision.
